title: Ignition Specifications — 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT
introduction:
Combustion starts with a spark across the plug's controlled gap, supplied by the ignition coil. I treat this small table as an engine-specific reference card: easy to read, but still worth matching carefully before the toolbox opens.

The Spark plug row contains the printed identifier. The gap row contains a range with inch and millimeter expressions; keep the endpoints together rather than turning the range into a guessed preferred setting. This page does not establish a complete replacement ordering number or provide plug removal, adjustment and installation instructions.

edits.text: Spark Plug Identification and Gap Range
edits.why: Use the table for the stated engine configuration, distinguishing the plug identifier from the gap dimension. The printed range defines the specification shown here; it supplies neither an adjustment method nor evidence that a particular ignition complaint is caused by the plugs.
